title: Clearer vote buttons on proposals
description: Ryan called the current button UX terrible (2026-10-25). Count the reader's own vote immediately, fill the pressed button and say 'You voted up · Undo', show 'Sending…' while the vote is in flight, and open the queue on the group with the most open proposals.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Live 2026-10-25 (Shipped #93): your own vote counts at once, the pressed button is filled with 'You voted up · Undo', 'Sending…' shows while in flight, the signed-out note is prominent, the queue opens on the group in steering, and phone touch targets are 48 px.
